=== commit message ===
feat: streaming pipeline — transcribe segments live during recording

New pipeline architecture replaces the old sequential-after-stop approach:

- Every 3s during recording, streamCheckAndDispatch() checks if a
  silence-bounded 25s segment is ready and dispatches it to whisper
  immediately, while recording continues
- dispatchSegment() runs ffmpeg concat + whisper-cli fully async; multiple
  segments can run concurrently (each is an independent task)
- onPipelineDone() collects results in order; once all done, pipelineFinalize()
  assembles and inserts the full text
- doFinalTranscription() now only handles remaining unchunked audio, then
  sets pipelineFinalizing=true and triggers finalization
- pipelineReset() called at start of each recording to clear state

Latency improvement for a 60s dictation:
  Before: stop → wait ~25s for all segments → text inserted
  After:  stop → wait ~5s for tail segment only → text inserted
  (first and second segments already transcribed during recording)
